Selected institutional claims were subject to independent limited assurance by NPSY & Co. under SAE 3000, with a separate SRS 4400 report of factual findings. Both reports are dated 3 September 2026 and relate to records/claims as at 17 July 2026.

INDEPENDENT EXTERNAL ASSURANCE · VERIFIED UDIN RECORDS

Independent reports. Verified references.

NPSY & Co., Chartered Accountants examined specified institutional claims and issued two signed reports. The reports record 31,052,382 services, 792,614 beneficiary/family registrations and 2.7 billion+ structured records under their stated definitions.

Signed 3 September 2026 · records as at 17 July 2026 · N Prasada Rao, Partner (membership 200027; firm 013580S).

See what each report covers

Two reports. Two kinds of evidence.

Section link

SAE 3000 gives limited assurance over the enumerated assertions against the Board-adopted criteria. SRS 4400 records the findings of agreed procedures; it does not express an audit opinion or an assurance conclusion.

ICAI provides the standards and UDIN verification mechanism. The independent report issuer is NPSY & Co. The UDIN identifies its report; the report and annexures define what was examined.

Website source inspection: 19 September 2026. Both signed reports and their annexures were inspected. Both UDINs were matched in the live ICAI portal on 19 September 2026 and showed Active, with practitioner and signing particulars matching the supplied references. Read the dated verification record. Open ICAI’s UDIN portal.

SAE 3000 · ICAI receipt, page 2SRS 4400 · ICAI receipt, page 1

The original two-page portal receipt was generated on 19 September 2026 at 14:30:38. Page 1 records SRS 4400; page 2 records the SAE 3000 report reference. Both show Active.
